name: Survey tile in Libra
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 0.5 degrees north of the ecliptic in Libra, imaged by SPHEREx 14 times in 5 visits over 44 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 26 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 41 hours starting 2025-07-12, at wavelengths from 1.17 to 4.93 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
